title: Resume a session from the same device without a new code, for 12 hours
spec: Two more first requests on a device connection (signin::Opening): Resume (tag 35) and End (tag 36), each followed by the 43-character session token a sign-in returned; replies Accepted with the same token or Refused for Resume, Ended (tag 165) for End. decode_request still refuses both. The server resumes a session only over the connection of the device it belongs to (the exact live certificate), while less than 12 hours (ABSOLUTE_MS) have passed since the sign-in, however long it was idle (Sessions::resume_hash_for, AccountStore::resume_session_by_hash); End revokes it only for that device (end_session_by_hash, journaled). DeviceAuth gains resume and end, refusing by default. The client keeps the token (ChatSession::token, SignedInSession::resume_ticket, ResumeTicket with a redacted Debug) and the worker resumes: after a lost connection it keeps the window signed in and resumes when the server answers; a TicketKeeper keeps the ticket between runs, and a held ticket is tried at start. A resume that fails after the TLS handshake (refused, or a server that cannot resume) forgets the ticket and reports SessionEnded (the window: signed out, 'Your session has ended. Sign in again with a new code.'). Signing out asks the server to end the session and forgets the ticket; a new enrollment forgets it too. The app keeps the ticket in resume-ticket in its data folder (email and token, one per line, owner-only, written atomically, a looser or linked file ignored).
